Oriel Noodle Bar, 22 Corwin Street

Beginning on Monday, November 16, Oriel Noodle Bar will no longer accept telephone orders for takeout. Instead, customers may place orders through our Web site or at the counter. Online orders can be scheduled up to two days in advance, and customers will receive a text message when their food is ready for pickup.

Thank you for your understanding.
